title: Alignment Bundle Clawback on Life-of-Tread Cancellations
content:
When a Crestline Road Hazard Life-of-Tread Protection certificate is cancelled and refunded on the Life-of-Tread cancellation refund, an Alignment Services & Plans plan sold with it is clawed back from the refund.

**Life-of-Tread bundle clawback.** When the vehicle has a Crestline alignment plan in status active that was sold on the certificate's own purchase ticket, 20 USD is taken back from the refund; when the active alignment plan was sold on another ticket dated no more than 30 days from the certificate's purchase date (before or after it), 10 USD is taken back; otherwise nothing is taken back.

| Active alignment plan on the vehicle | Ticket it was sold on | Clawback |
|---|---|---|
| yes | the certificate's own purchase ticket | 20.00 |
| yes | another ticket dated within 30 days of the certificate's purchase date | 10.00 |
| yes | another ticket dated more than 30 days from it | none |
| no | — | none |

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** Certificate bought April 10: an active alignment plan sold on a separate ticket dated May 10 (30 days later) or March 11 (30 days earlier) is clawed back 10.00; one sold May 11 is not. An alignment plan that has expired or been cancelled is not an active plan.
